payload.body: 2021 BITCOIN ANALYSIS & FORECAST by Binance Killers ® ➖➖➖➖➖➖➖ Bitcoin has had great years and disgusting years throughout it's history. One of it's best years until now has been 2020 (Almost 10xing its value) and we do expect 2021 to be a continuation of 2020. Our targets to $BTC this year are 50K, 65K, 80K and 100K respectively. Although it's likely we only hit 65K or 80K this year, we are certain of all targets being acheived in the next 1 or 2 years (long term hold). We will be watching out for 50K as we do expect a big correction (+30%) after reaching it. We will sell most of our holding between 50K and 55K, expecting to rebuy at our most important support levels (26K, 20K and 14K) Upside Levels 1. 50,000 2. 65,000 3. 80,000 3. 100,000 Downside Levels 1. 26,000 2. 20,000 3. 14,000 Even though both major players ( $BTC and $ETH ) can have some very steep drops before reaching our higher targets, we do expect this year to be Bullish ➖➖➖➖➖➖➖ This message cannot be forwarded or replicated - Binance Killers®
